Thanks to the relentless investigative efforts of the USBP RGV Sector Targeting Unit, two smugglers were sentenced for their roles in a deadly human smuggling attempt in April 2025. 
 
In an attempt to evade law enforcement, the smuggler drove into a canal leading to the unfortunate death of a woman and 14-year-old child.
They gambled with lives for money and now they have been sentenced to prison time. 
 
🔺Vicente Garcia Jr. - Sentenced to 72 months’ confinement at just 18 years old.
🔺Jose Alexis Baeza–Combaluzier (Driver)- Sentenced to 96 months’ confinement.

tweets.text:
NOT YOUR AVERAGE FAMILY OUTING – DRUG HAUL STOPPED! 

A father and son were caught transporting 63 lbs. of cocaine through Escondido, CA. USBP and members of the San Diego County Sheriff’s Interdiction Team stopped the duo near I-15 and discovered 23 packages hidden in the vehicle’s floor. They are now pending state drug charges.
 
We are cracking down on criminal smuggling organizations to ensure illicit cargo like this never reaches our communities.

@USBPChiefSDC @CBP

tweets.text:
In Laredo, TX, two human smugglers led USBP and Texas DPS on a high-speed pursuit with five people stuffed in their vehicle - including an unaccompanied minor.  All individuals in the vehicle were unharmed and bailed out trying to avoid apprehension but were quickly arrested.   
 
Both suspects are now facing state human smuggling charges, and the illegal aliens will be processed according to immigration law.
 
Let’s get one thing straight: human smugglers aren’t “helping” anyone. They are criminals endangering public safety and treating human beings like disposable cargo. Don’t fall for it.

@USBPChiefLRT

COCAINE LOAD INTERCEPTED⛔
 
A drug smuggling attempt came to a hard stop at a USBP Immigration Checkpoint in Sierra Blanca, TX, after an X-ray inspection exposed suspicious anomalies hidden in a secret compartment. Inside the compartment, agents found 14 bundles of cocaine totaling 36 lbs. with an estimated street value of $526,000.
 
The driver, a U.S. citizen, was arrested and turned over to DEA.
